title: TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: TriTD：面向实时自回归视频生成的三方轨迹-分布蒸馏

paragraphs.en: TriTD框架通过三模块协同蒸馏优化误差来源，实现单张H100上26.8 FPS的实时自回归视频生成。 Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.
paragraphs.zh: TriTD框架通过三模块协同蒸馏优化误差来源，实现单张H100上26.8 FPS的实时自回归视频生成。自回归（AR）视频扩散已成为高效视频生成的主流范式，但其实际部署仍受限于生成质量与推理效率之间的权衡。 我们将这一瓶颈归因于AR rollout中的三类误差来源：基础模型误差、训练与推理分布失配，以及上游误差传播。 基于这一分解，我们推导出单步误差与累积误差的闭式上界，为联合优化生成质量与推理效率提供了理论依据。 在该分析的指导下，我们提出TriTD，一个三方轨迹-分布协同优化蒸馏框架，包含三个互补模块。 首先，在ODE初始化方面，我们采用下一节点轨迹蒸馏（NTD）目标，缩短了监督范围并获得更低的回归误差下界。 其次，我们提出分块渐变加噪（CGN），一种逐块单调非递减的加噪调度，有助于缩小预期的训练-推理噪声失配，并消除冗余的KV-cache更新，在不损失质量的前提下带来显著加速。 第三，我们提出正交-并行DMD（OP-DMD），一种分布匹配损失，在保留原始DMD监督的同时，在正交子空间中引入额外的回归约束以抑制离轴漂移，同时提升了训练稳定性与最终生成质量。 大量实验表明，TriTD在视觉质量上持续超越现有基线，同时在单张H100 GPU上达到26.8 FPS的实时吞吐量，为交互式流式视频生成提供了质量与效率均衡的解决方案。
